review: Blanket ToAccountInfo returns self.as_ref().clone(); the replacement uses the same safe Program AsRef and copies every AccountInfo field.
The additional helper copies only the Rc handle, increments the same strong Cell once, preserves the weak count and RefCell borrow state, and does not copy the inner mutable lamports reference.

The original live Rc remains owned by the borrowed account. There is no callback, allocator or unwind point between the raw count increment and returned handle. Normal AccountInfo drop balances one extra strong owner.
NonNull pointer loads/casts preserve allocation provenance without integer conversion. The raw usize store targets the concrete strong Cell interior, not Rc storage or account payload.

On the pinned target the default-Global Rc is8bytes/alignment8, Global0 and the pointer field is the only nonzero-size Rc field; RcBox is repr(C) with the strong Cell first. These are conditional private-layout facts, not a public Rc ABI guarantee.
s!=0 is valid only for the initialized live inputRc. The wrapping increment/store followed by zero trap preserves the pinned standard clone overflow abort.
expect.with.probability returns n==0; the expected=true, finite constant0.00002 lies in0..1. It is not an assume that overflow is false and produces no new runtime float calculation.
Existing owner load, sharing compare probability and safely repaired sharing-CPI Program pin remain preserved.
limits: Pinned compiler/standard-library/default allocator representation and valid single-threaded liveRc inputs are required.
Finite runtime and partial token progress are separate acceptance gates; no whole-program identity or historical source claim.
